about_short_description.short_description: Glide is a no-code app development platform that helps businesses build custom, AI-based apps without coding.

product.name: Glide No Code App Builder
product.description: A platform to build custom business apps from spreadsheets and other data sources without coding.

product.name: Glide AI
product.description: An AI-powered feature that automates tasks and generates content within Glide apps using managed AI models.

product.name: Glide Data Sources
product.description: Connect and sync various data sources like spreadsheets and SQL databases to build and manage app data.

product.name: Glide Workflows
product.description: A tool to create automated workflows that trigger actions and route logic within Glide apps.

product.name: Glide Pre-Built Business Apps
product.description: Customizable app templates for business functions like portals, dashboards, CRM, inventory, and field sales.

product.name: Glide Enterprise Solutions
product.description: Enterprise-grade no-code platform with advanced security, scalability, and support for large organizations.
